Dev Patel
Backend Engineer | Chennai, Tamil Nadu
dev.patel450@example.com | +91 9655229079

Backend-focused engineer with experience building scalable services and data pipelines for enterprise applications. Comfortable translating product requirements into robust APIs and microservices, and optimizing data workflows for performance and cost. Open to relocating to Mumbai or Delhi NCR. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience
Capgemini — Sep 2025 - Present
Backend Engineer (Remote)
- Designed and delivered REST APIs for a customer billing microservice, reducing average API latency from 420ms to 160ms through query optimization and improved serialization.
- Implemented Redis-based caching layer for session and frequently-accessed lookup data, cutting DB read load by 58% and reducing page response times by 35%.
- Built and deployed resilient microservices on EC2 with autoscaling and SQS-driven background processing, resulting in 99.95% uptime for critical workflows.
- Collaborated via Confluence and Jira to document API contracts and runbooks; introduced contract tests that prevented 3 production regressions in 6 months.

Zentrix Labs — Sep 2023 - Aug 2025
Big Data Engineer (On-site)
- Developed Python 3 ETL pipelines to ingest and transform daily event data, improving end-to-end pipeline throughput by 3x and lowering processing cost per GB by 28%.
- Authored and optimized complex SQL queries for analytics and reporting, trimming query runtime from minutes to seconds for core dashboards.
- Integrated Lambda functions for lightweight transformation tasks and SQS for decoupled job orchestration, increasing system resiliency and parallelism.
- Maintained technical documentation in Confluence and tracked sprint work in Jira; mentored junior engineers on best practices for pipeline testing.

Projects
- Transaction Reconciliation Tool — Built a Django web app to reconcile transaction records across systems using SQL-based matching logic; reduced manual reconciliation time by 70%.
- Real-time Cache Warmup Service — Implemented a Redis warmup microservice using Python and SQS to pre-populate cache after deploys, preventing cold-start spikes.

Languages: Python 3, SQL
